summary: StartX offers a fee-free, equity-free accelerator for Stanford-affiliated founders. Its FAQ gives approximate seasonal application windows, but no precise next cutoff was confirmed. The November 1 homepage deadline belongs to the separate StartX Fellows program.

sources.title: StartX official program
sources.supports: Stanford founder community with no equity or fees. The accelerator provides mentorship, resources and investor access. No accelerator deadline was confirmed; the homepage November 1 Fellows deadline is a different program.

sources.title: StartX FAQs
sources.supports: At least one founder generally needs qualifying Stanford affiliation. Approximate application seasons: mid-January to mid-February, mid-May to mid-June, early September to early October; no exact next cutoff.

notes: Do not use the Fellows application deadline for the accelerator. Seasonal month ranges are not precise dates and are not extrapolated to a future cohort.
Qualifying Stanford affiliation and meaningful equity ownership are generally required; the FAQ describes case-by-case exceptions with strong community recommendations.
